chapters.title: 1. Trump pulls Vance off the Iran talks and says the U.S. does not need a deal — When does strength mean refusing to negotiate, and when does it mean being willing to make peace? And can leaders fight corruption fairly if they only look at their opponents?

2. Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, and the President says Tim Cook should replace him — How much does a leader's private character count in public trust? And does a great founder belong to his company, or does the company have to be able to outlive him?

3. UK schools and libraries split over pulling David Walliams' books — Can a work be separated from the person who made it? And when the two are tied together, how do we protect children without punishing someone on accusations alone?

4. Pope Leo, home in Peru, denounces machismo and tells bishops to face abuse with truth and justice — Is the Church's first duty to teach the truth or to heal the wounded, and can it do one without the other?
